title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The public reader surface remains the curated numbered-paper corpus: cumulative readers, standalone English paper PDFs, compact language/source packages, and scoped source-audit correction packets.

Pending local upload queue. After the latest public version, local staging adds RA37/RA40/RA41 for Paper 04, RA42 Paper 05, RA43-RA45 Paper 06 pp.161-178, Paper 03/Paper 11/Paper 12/Paper 13 GDZ source/provenance witness support, Paper 06 GDZ remaining-source witness pp.173-196, targeted Paper 06/Paper 07/Paper 08 audit drops, Paper 14 source-audit results, Paper 15/Paper 16/Paper 17/Paper 18/Paper 19 source-audit fixes, Paper 20 Lean/source-audit formula-fix material, and German source-audit support companions. These pending files are not public Zenodo files until a token-backed upload/publish pass succeeds.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts, translation drafts, source/provenance witnesses, and source-audit correction packets; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Known open items. Paper 02 body pp.23-90 is closed at the RA29/RA30 page-level standard, Tabelle I p.91 is source-checked at RA31, and Tabelle II p.92 rows 0-23 are checked at plate-row level through RA33/RA34. RA41 reports Paper 04 pp.118-154 source-symbol closure at the current standard. RA45 reports Paper 06 pp.161-178 checked, while the separate GDZ witness packet supplies pp.173-196 images and p.179 onward TeX correction remains open. Paper 03/Paper 11/Paper 12 source packages are provenance/witness support only; Paper 13 has actionable audit findings but no applied TeX branch yet. Final Paper 02 equation-tag/display-layout inventory, non-German propagation to EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH, and full symbol-level source audit beyond the checked tranches remain queued.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
